page.title: Retro terminal video template for dev tools, free
page.description: A green-screen terminal promo video from your screenshots: typed captions, scanlines and glitch cuts. Made for CLIs and dev tools. Free, in your browser.
page.blurb: Phosphor green on black, scanlines, and captions that type themselves out. Screens open inside a terminal window and cut with a glitch. Developers read it instantly as a tool made for them.
